capabilities: compile daily notes from a start and end date into one note
preset ranges for last week or last month
choose the daily notes source folder
choose the destination folder for the compiled note
extras: README states it is for the Obsidian desktop version only and gives manual installation instructions rather than community-plugin install steps.
problem: Obsidian's daily notes create one file per day, so reading across a week or month means opening each file separately; there is no built-in way to merge a date range into one note.
summary: Desktop plugin that compiles daily notes or journals from a selected date range into a single compiled note.
